newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota declines to confirm Russian venture report.
newsitem.headline: Toyota declines to confirm Russian venture report.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp on Wednesday declined to confirm a newspaper report that it has agreed to undertake a feasibility study with the Moscow municipal government on producing commercial vehicles at an idle military factory.
A Toyota spokesman declined to reply to a question on whether discussions were taking place, and would say only: "Nothing has been decided."

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its Wednesday edition that Toyota plans to spend about 10 billion yen to transform a closed military plant into an assembly centre for its Hi Ace vans, making 3,000 to 4,000 vans annually from knockdown kits.
Toyota will dispatch technicians to Moscow as early as this month and expects to complete the study by March, the paper said.
